notes: Enright Avenue: the avenue running south from West 8th at x~7000 is printed only 'AVENUE' near y 700-1000; 'ENRIGHT' is printed on the same street at y 4300-4500, so both are taken as Enright Avenue. West 8th Street runs along the top (name not printed in this strip). 'SEDLER' printed without a suffix (written Sedler Street). Delhi Avenue name read at x~5450 ('DELHI'), 'AVENUE' at x~7100 along the bottom. Fairbanks/Delhi crossing sits at the plate's bottom-right cut; Fairbanks may continue south off the plate. A street tab (illegible name) meets West 8th from the north at x~5930, just outside the pick range, not recorded. 'NOT OPEN' 25 ft strip east of Enright at y~4770 recorded as alley. Orange/green bands (e.g. 'Frank Vanderhorst' strip x 7400-7830, y 4950-6200) are tract boundaries, not streets.
